It belongs to the Risk Function (RISK) of BNP Paribas and is placed under the responsibility of the Chief Operational Risk Officer (CORO), who reports to the CRO of BNP Paribas. The department has responsibility for independently challenging and supervising the Operational Risk management of the whole Group including for the main business domains (also called Poles or Operating divisions) of CIB, CPBS and IPS. Additionally, there is responsibility to cover the Assets Liability Management and Treasury (ALM-T) operations too. This is achieved through: framing operational risk methodology and disseminating of risk management culture across the Group; assessing the adequacy of the operational risk management set-up; controlling effectiveness of Group’s control environment; contributing to the detection, anticipation and response to risks; alerting business and RISK stakeholders on any significant risk issue; providing a consolidated view on Group’s operational risks profile. As the second line of defence for Fraud risk management (interchangeably called Anti-Fraud), RISK ORM has the responsibility for oversight and supervision on Fraud risks, ensuring and opining that appropriate Fraud risk management efforts are underway and raise any alerts in case of issues to the stability of the Bank and influencing business, functions and technology partners to take sound risk management decisions. Position Purpose: Located within the RISK Function of BNP Paribas (“BNPP”), the role of Operational Risk Officer Anti-Fraud (AF) APAC is to ensure that they support implementation of operational risk management framework and to provide RISK ORM APAC and business senior management with relevant, synthetic, transparent, exhaustive and consistent information and a front-to-back view of operational risk across AF APAC activities. To achieve this objective, this 2nd line of defense (“LOD2”) role works closely with other RISK ORM regional teams and with BNPP APAC top management and stakeholders. Operational Risk Officer in ISPL will be a member of the extended RISK ORM Anti-Fraud APAC team. He / she reports hierarchically to the Head of RISK ORM ISPL CoE and functionally to Head of RISK ORM Anti-Fraud APAC. Choose your profile You are Trade Finance Operations- Service Quality and Support Job Title: Trade Finance Operations - Service Quality and Support Department: : GTFO - Service Quality and Support About Business line/Function: GTFO(Global Trade Finance Operations) is responsible for the Back Office Operations on Documentary Trade Finance, Import & Export, Collections etc., and Guarantees Operations. The team supports a wide range of Trade Finance services across APAC & EMEA regions. Position Purpose: The platform supports countries across globe in APAC & EMEA with standard trade applications. The position is required to support GTFO Trade finance teams in daily issues involved around BAU, streamline processes, SLA, Improve Quality and manage Incidents, RCA and Remediation’s, support other Trade teams in GTFO including IT initiatives. Contribute to Projects related to growth/optimization and Monitoring of platform performance for outsourced provider and BNPP Operations. Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities Monitor and Support GTFO Service delivery, Project Management PERFORMANCE MONITORING, BAU Support & Quality, ANALYSIS AND REPORTING: I. Run Stabilization and Optimization: · Ensure maintenance of Standard Operating Procedure (SOPs) section-wise (imports / Exports / product Transverse / Support SOPs) and inform the Head - Organization and Support · Propose enhancements and quick wins (process, organization or system) and supervise alignment on best practices · Follow up and challenge partner's continuous improvement initiatives (FMEA: Failure Model Error Analysis) · Optimization activities and monitor possible dependencies with transition activities. · Ensure Continuous improvements by leading Optimization initiatives to improve platform monitoring, reduce inefficiencies, control risks, standardize processes, automation proposals. · Analyse performance measures and report in a timely fashion with a focus and depth relevant to the client stakeholders: - Most of the indicators will be provided by the supplier (IBM Workflow Management) - Some data will be maintained and monitored directly by the Organization & Support team (e.g.: the users' access rights monitoring files, Error Log) · Liaise with BNPP Middle Offices for Performance Management issues, suggest process changes. · Contribute to service quality improvement · Chairing of SLA meetings with client sites: Enforce SLA commitments. · Jurisdiction Management, ISO Certification and Management · Intellimatch activities · BEACON and other reports. II. Transition activities: 1. Co-ordinate locally transition project office activities 2. Represent the Trade Finance COO in the Operation Center Set-up work stream for all aspects. 3. Facilitate complementary investigation onshore. 4. Support Partner's transition action plan, conclusions and implementation 5. Propose actions to secure ramp up phases and lead data migration and business rehearsal activities at GTFO level 6. Contribute to SOPs documentation prior to knowledge cascade 7. Transfer knowledge of Territories specificities internally with other team members II. Claims Management: 1. Perform Root Cause analysis and coordinate for correction. Manage accounting entries corrections in the accounting tool. 2. Monitor the effectiveness of Action Plan 3. Related SOPs: Customer Claims Processing, Processing of an error identified at BO level, Regularization / Reconciliation III. Performance Reporting: Responsible for coordinating/reporting on all BNPP MIS reports / Governance deck IV. Other Responsibilities A. Bring Direct contribution to BNPP operational permanent control framework B. Minimize operational failure, including but not exclusively the risk of fraud by helping to devise and by implementing sufficient regular controls C. Ensure appropriate escalation to management and/or permanent control (or compliance as appropriate) as soon as an issue is identified. D. Comply with internal and external regulatory and compliance requirements E. Comply with the BNPP standards of Code of Conduct F. Comply with the BNPP IT Security policies G. Anti‐Money Laundering / Financial Sanctions “AML/FS”) related duties: Operations are an integral part of the control framework including for AML/FS topics. In that respect, in performing your role you are expected to ensure adherence to AML/FS‐related Group Policies and execution of associated operational controls, and to promptly escalate any resulting hit for analysis and decision. Contributing Responsibilities · To contribute to the IT and Transversal projects from time to time. · Specific Qualifications (if required) · Graduate/post Graduate from a recognised university. · Certification in Trade Finance. Additional qualifications in CDCS & other ICC certification is an added advantage. · IIBF certifications is an added advantage. · Linguistic capabilities like French language is a plus. · Behavioural Skills: Good Communication skills, Client centric Approach, presentable, maintain office decorum etc. abide by the BNPP code of behavior and principles, BNPP values. Technical & Behavioral Competencies, Transversal skills · 5+ years of experience within Trade Finance /Back Office related Trade Operations · Strong communication skills with good level of written/Spoken English; · Good knowledge of MS office tools (Excel, Word, PPT) · Team management, Excellent interpersonal skills, Capacity to work in a multicultural environment and in a team; Ability to manage / facilitate a meeting. · Professionalism: resolution of problems, quality oriented, respect of the commitments; · Capacity to assist his/her colleagues, internal customers and his management. · Attention to detail/ Good analytical skills, Innovative thinking, Ability to Manage a project · Ability to understand, explain and Make a Change. Choose your profile You are Assistant Manager - Client Account Life Cycle Management Job Title: Assistant Manager (Custody Account Life Cycle Management) Department : Business Implementation About Business line/Function: Join a leading global financial institution and apply your analytical, problem‑solving, and communication expertise to BNP’s Custody account life cycle management team BNP’s mission is to act as a trusted custodian, partner, delivering responsible financial services that drive client growth and broader economic progress. The APAC Business Implementation function is responsible for the custody onboarding, ongoing maintenance & offboarding of all core custody management activities for our regional clients. Using a proven methodology, we manage implementations across diverse client sectors, delivering a superior client experience while accelerating revenue generation for the bank. Position Purpose: The Senior Client Custody Account Lifecycle associate at BNP Paribas leads the end‑to‑end management of custody account openings, modifications and closures across the APAC region. Operating independently yet in close partnership with senior stakeholders in Client Implementation, Product, Operations, Legal, Risk and Client Service, the analyst drives the complete onboarding journey—including the preparation and review of Account Opening Forms, segregated‑market lodgements, FX‑service setups and Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI). By analysing client data, assessing risk, ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory and internal policies, and communicating clear status updates to both internal teams and external clients, the analyst guarantees a smooth, compliant transition and ongoing administration for a diverse clientele of asset managers, pension funds, mutual funds, government entities and other institutional investors. In addition to delivering high‑quality client service, the senior analyst mentors junior team members, identifies process‑improvement opportunities, becoming a subject matter expert and contributes to the development of best‑practice standards, positioning the role as a key driver of operational excellence and growth within BNP Paribas’ Custody Services business. Responsibilities • Own the end‑to‑end processing and validation of client requests for account opening, maintenance and transitions; verify and authorise data entered in internal systems with a focus on precision and timeliness by becoming SME of the process • Interpret and apply current banking regulations, internal policies and risk‑management frameworks to every request; continuously monitor regulatory updates and promptly elevate any control‑related issues. • Partner with the Client Implementation Project Manager and senior stakeholders in Product, Operations, Legal, Risk, Relationship Management and Client Service to ensure a seamless, high‑quality client experience. • Maintain and enhance the New Business Tracker and associated databases; monitor onboarding project progress and deliver accurate status updates to clients and internal partners. • Design and orchestrate connectivity, SWIFT linkages, standing‑instruction setups and other operational prerequisites to achieve a fully‑functional custody environment (SWIFT, internal sites, external parties). • Lead market‑form lodgements for segregated‑account openings, acting as the primary liaison with sub‑custodians and guiding documentation through to finalisation and account activation. • Collect, configure and execute FX standing‑instruction requests, interest‑rate settings and asset‑transition activities, ensuring exact and on‑time implementation. • Communicate proactively with investment managers, clients and internal teams on onboarding status, risk considerations and regulatory changes, tailoring messages to the audience. • Deliver a client‑service‑focused approach in all interactions; respond to queries within agreed SLA terms and guarantee that all documentation, risk checks and approvals meet BNP Paribas standards. • Create, maintain and distribute Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) by consolidating custody and sub‑custodian details for clients and relevant stakeholders. Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities * The Drafting team is responsible for ensuring that all BNP Paribas confirmations are Dispatched to clients i.e Interbank and Corporate Clients. The team covers a wide range of products traded by the Trading desks such as Vanilla products and the more complex Structured trades. * The Drafting team is also responsible for performing final verification of the trade economics before dispatching the final confirmations to counterparts. * The team works closely with other Trade Processing teams, legal teams and Front Office to ensure timely communication for any booking discrepancies, template issues and outstanding confirmations. * Also, in the light of EMIR regulation and risk reduction, the target is to match all confirmations within one day and globally to reduce the outstanding confirmations delay. * Confirmation Drafting/Execution responsibilities: 1. To draft confirmations with counterparts for wide range of Products including Foreign Exchange, Money Market, Equity Derivatives, Credit and Interest Rate Derivatives. 2. To perform final verification of the trade economics before sending the final confirmation to counterparts 3. To support secondary events during the product life cycle such as Novation, Early Termination, etc. 4. To closely comply with EMIR, FED and Dodd-Franck regulation 5. To follow up any type of amendments requests 6. Draft and validate ISDA/AFB confirmations by referencing booking systems and term sheets for both financial institutions and corporate clients 7. Ensure confirmations are sent or suppressed in accordance with procedure 8. Ensure accurate completion of drafting tasks within the internal service level agreements, client requirement and regulatory timelines 9. Prepare draft confirmations for potential trades as necessary 10. Customer Services b. To be customer-focused and maintain a high quality services standard Contributing Responsibilities * Continuous Control & Improvement: a. arrangements and provide risk opinions under the supervision of the related ORO: o Ensure that new/renewed arrangements on the perimeter are managed in compliance with Group Outsourcing procedure (RISK0417) and Group Third Party Technology Risk Management procedure (ITG0111 – TPTRM procedure) o Ensure new initiatives to outsource on a Cloud are compliant with the Group Cloud blueprint and Group ICT and Cyber policies; o At each phase of the TPRM/TPTRM process, review and challenge risk analysis conducted by 1LoD stakeholders (including ICT risk analysis) and provide risk opinions · Oversee the process of the outsourcing register data quality of regulatory reporting: o Define the process to remediate data quality anomalies for CASPER regulatory reporting, o Perform cross-business consistency analysis to identify inconsistencies or incorrect qualifications in the register, o Identify any inconsistencies between the outsourcing register critical outsourcing arrangements data and IMAS portal, o Build a process to ensure consistency between the outsourcing register and the exit strategy standard documentation (e.g., alignment between the exit plan and the outcome of assessment of the service provider’s substitutability, the substitutability modality, and the time-of-service provider’s substitutability). · Verify the compliance of outsourcing regulatory documentation: o Build a process and perform the verification, with the related OROs, of the alignment between the draft record in IMAS portal and the content of the notification template submitted at the Validation Committee, o Build a process and perform the verification, with the related OROs, that the exit strategy documentation is available and compliant with the Group format. · Execute LoD2 controls on outsourcing GCL (RISK0418): o Define a process to industrialise the LOD2 control reviews on outsourcing. o Perform the defined LoD2 controls plan, share the results with the related OROs and ensure that the related potential permanent control actions plans are recorded in 360 RiskOp. · Facilitate and pilot outsourcing operational risk management framework: o Define a process to industrialise the periodic report analysing the outsourcing operational risk management including the data quality indicators improvements and the LoD2 controls results analysis, o Monitor indicators results, and cascade as appropriate to ORO Poles and Functions, o Define and produce operational reporting (link with RISK ORM COE ISPL reporting stream). Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities Infrastructure and Technical 1. Build AI-augmented support workflows Design and implement support workflows that allow Twin users to raise issues, ask questions and provide feedback directly through Twin. Responsibilities include: · Implement conversational support flows inside Twin. · Build support prompts and agent workflows for user assistance. · Create AI-based classification of support requests. · Distinguish between usage issues, access issues, missing knowledge, wrong answers, hallucinations, latency, agent defects and platform defects. · Implement automatic routing rules toward Twin Core, Twin Infra, Twin Solve, Twin Change, Twin Logs …or Knowledge Management. · Create support journeys for written voice and potentially multimodal interactions. 2. Engineer feedback capture and feedback analysis Develop the mechanisms that capture and exploit user feedback from the Twin interface. Responsibilities include: · Implement structured feedback forms embedded in Twin. · Capture user ratings, comments, complaints and correction requests. · Design feedback metadata: agent, franchise, source, question type, answer type, severity, business impact, user population. · Build classification pipelines for user feedback. · Detect recurring feedback patterns. · Identify issues that should become backlog items. · Store validated feedback in a dedicated support knowledge base. · Connect feedback insights to Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence or equivalent platforms where relevant. 3. Implement AI triage and intelligent routing Build technical components that automatically analyze support requests and route them to the appropriate resolution path. Responsibilities include: · Develop AI triage logic for incoming support cases. · Build severity and priority scoring mechanisms. · Implement automatic clustering of similar issues. · Detect repeated complaints on the same agent, source, franchise or feature. · Create rules for escalation to human support or expert teams. · Build integration with existing ITSM or backlog tools. · Automate low-risk responses where possible. · Generate response suggestions for support analysts. 4. Improve Twin’s self-support capabilities Make Twin progressively capable of answering questions about its own usage, limits and behavior. Responsibilities include: · Build and maintain support-specific prompts. · Create and test Twin self-help agents. · Integrate support knowledge into RAG / GraphRAG pipelines. · Implement grounding mechanisms so support answers are based on validated documentation. · Detect when Twin should answer directly and when it should escalate. · Improve answer templates for recurring support questions. · Test support journeys from an end-user perspective. · Measure the accuracy and usefulness of support answers. 5. Monitor AI support performance Create technical monitoring for the quality and performance of the Twin support experience. Responsibilities include: · Build dashboards for support engineering metrics. · Track user complaint rate, escalation rate, unresolved issues and recurring issues. · Monitor AI self-resolution rate. · Track response suggestion acceptance rate. · Detect abnormal increases in complaints after releases. · Monitor supports automation accuracy. · Analyze false routing and incorrect classifications. · Provide technical evidence to Twin Core and franchise teams. 6. Contribute to continuous improvement of Twin agents Use support signals to improve the overall Twin ecosystem. Responsibilities include: · Identify recurring agent failures. · Identify gaps in user documentation. · Detect missing or outdated knowledge. · Identify confusing user journeys. · Provide structured inputs to Product Owners and engineering teams. · Convert support issues into actionable improvement tickets. · Participate in testing fixes after agent, knowledge or workflow improvements. · Support non-regression testing of Twin support features. Supervised technologies: · Understanding of agentic architecture. · Expertise RAG / GraphRAG. · Data & Quality Governance. · Intercultural communication. · Leadership and knowledge of the BNP context. It delivers end‑to‑end trade lifecycle services—including confirmation, collateral management, DVP settlement and exception handling—while adhering to the highest standards of risk control, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. Leveraging a unified technology platform and a worldwide network of clearing partners, the team ensures seamless, timely and secure settlement outcomes that underpin BNP Paribas’s liquidity and pricing capabilities in the FX‑MM markets. Position Purpose: The EQD CIT Back‑Office is responsible for the end‑to‑end settlement of derivative and money‑market trades. The team works closely with marketers, sales, and other internal functions (APAC & EMEA) to deliver “client‑first” post‑trade services. It ensures that all settlement controls, position processes and regulatory requirements are applied consistently, accurately and efficiently. Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities • Process value‑date and value‑date‑1 payments; ensure clearing. • Create manual SWIFT payments (MT103, MT202, MTMX). • Approve and process corporate / inter‑bank trades timely. • Execute cash settlement with on‑shore / off‑shore clients. • Manage cash‑funding activities related to trades. • Perform end‑of‑day (EOD) reconciliations. • Troubleshoot operational issues and resolve them promptly. • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies and procedures. Contributing Responsibilities • Continuous review of processes & controls to maintain high‑level risk management. • Report system failures to the relevant IT development team. • Enrich the investigation / settlement tools with relevant data. • Support Finance on sensitive‑account follow‑up. • Participate in daily CLS / DTCC pre‑matching and break‑resolution. • Contribute to quarterly Credit‑Roll cash‑flow reconciliation. • Liaise with front‑office, middle‑office and external counterparties as required. • Assist in maintaining the “associated‑person” compliance record (background check). Technical & Behavioral Competencies • Strong knowledge of FXMM and OTC/EQD‑derivatives products & processes. • Proficiency with SWIFT messaging (MT103, MT202, MTMX). • Experience with CLS / DTCC matching, break‑resolution. • Accurate cash‑settlement and funding management. • End‑of‑day reconciliation and cash‑flow management. • Understanding of regulatory & risk‑management frameworks. • Familiarity with settlement control tools & investigation systems. • Analytical thinking & problem‑solving. • Effective communication & stakeholder‑management. • Ability to work under pressure in a fast‑paced environment. • Attention to detail and strong sense of ownership. • Pro‑active attitude toward continuous improvement. • Team‑oriented collaboration across geographies. • Integrity and adherence to compliance (associated‑person) standards. The below requirement is for Operational Risk Officer- ICT Controls Testing role which part of the Common ICT LoD2 Controls Execution Platform (CICEP) under Group RISK ORM Network team. The candidate will be part of The Bank’s 2nd line of defense function, and they will be responsible for testing the deployment, and effectiveness of the IT and Cyber controls globally. The position is based in India Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (ISPL), Mumbai and reports to the Head of CICEP (India CoE), plus functionally to Group Head of ICT Controls Testing. Key success of the CICEP relies on building trusted partnerships with stakeholders and particularly with the ORM Network community and globally, with all entities of the Group. deficiencies and provide practical recommendations for remediation. · Identify areas of improvement for ICT control testing and assist with the enhancement of the methodologies / tools for carrying
